name: horizontal-scroll-rail
title: Horizontal scroll rail
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A sticky section whose vertical scroll drives a horizontal rail. Narrow viewports and reduced motion use a native scroller.

docs: Clean-room horizontal rail. No Motion UI or Motion+ source. On a wide screen with motion allowed, the pane fills the viewport and the section grows by the track overflow (ResizeObserver). Vertical scroll translates the track until the section end meets the bottom of that pane. Reduced motion, and viewports under minWidth, keep a native horizontal scroller with scroll-snap and the author pane height. Arrow keys move the rail. Focusable items scroll into view. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, use-scroll-progress, motion-preference, or another file the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
